chunks: And Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far, peace be upon them both, said:
"No sacrifice is to be made with anything from the domesticated birds."

key_terms.الدَّوَاجِنِ: domesticated birds or fowl kept in homes
key_terms.شَيْءٍ: anything or any kind of item

ai.seo_question: Can domesticated birds be used for sacrificial offerings in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding sacrificial offerings, stating that domesticated birds are not valid for udhiyah. It reflects the fiqh boundaries on what animals may be used in ritual sacrifice.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3064 - Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as) said:
"No sacrifice is to be made with any of the domesticated birds."
